target_customer: Consumers with acne, eczema or aging concerns who buy a phone attachment plus an app subscription-style coaching service
problem: People cannot see skin changes that happen below the surface or track causes of flare-ups over time, so product choices are guesswork.
business_model: Consumer hardware (Lumoscope phone clip, preorder price reported at 199 to 329 USD) plus AI app (Lumi)
product_category: Consumer skin imaging hardware and AI skin health app

founders.name: Maryanne Alhallak
education: UC Berkeley, BS Bioengineering and BA Economics (YC bio); Berkeley SCET lists BA Economics 2026
previous_startups: Unnamed biotech startup she says exited in 1.5 years (self-reported, unverified)
founders.background_notes: YC bio says she was admitted to Berkeley at 15 and is also a beauty and lifestyle creator.

founders.name: Anthea Guo
prior_employers: Google (team lead on a Berkeley collaboration on DeepVariant)
education: UC Berkeley, BE EECS 2026 with a minor in Bioengineering (Berkeley SCET)
founders.background_notes: Co-founded Computational Biology at Berkeley (student group). SCET says she developed severe eczema as a sophomore, which motivated the company.

competitors.name: Perfect Corp skin analysis (software and hardware guides)
competitors.what: AI skin analysis software sold to brands and retailers, alongside clinic hardware such as VISIA
competitors.traction_then: established B2B vendor; consumer hardware not its focus

technical_complexity.rationale: Multispectral phone clip, image pipeline and a personalization model are standard hard-ish engineering for three people; a third-party directory claims the optics match off-the-shelf Alibaba dermatoscopes, which would lower hardware difficulty (unverified).

defensibility.rationale: Hardware appears to be commodity optics per a third-party claim; the only moat is a longitudinal per-user skin history, which needs scale first.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of late 2026 no incumbent response is documented; the company is in preorder stage.

market_need_then: Large consumer skincare spend and an existing market of skin analysis apps; founder Guo cites personal eczema experience. No independent demand data found; the company claims a 24 hour first batch sellout per a Chinese-language article (unverified).

branding.domain_note: Main site lumeria.com and product site lumeria.skin per the YC page; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.mascot_or_character: AI assistant named Lumi (not a visual mascot)
identity.visual_style: Clean, clinical, polished, sunlit bathroom and garden imagery, side by side visible and UV views (own site)
identity.voice_and_tone: Science-forward with urgency tactics: countdown timers, discount banners, taglines such as Your skin, understood

branding.brand_signature: The Oura Ring for Skin positioning line
branding.community_and_virality: Founder Alhallak reports 26k plus followers and millions of views on creator content (self-reported, figures conflict between pages); trade and trend press covered the launch.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage; the analogy line is memorable but the name is shared with unrelated trademarks (a registered LUMERIA mark exists for another owner) and there is little independent brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Lumeria is an active Summer 2026 company at preorder stage, so there is no outcome yet. The launch drew trade press and a founder audience, but a third-party directory says no FDA record exists and questions the hardware claims, and no funding round has been confirmed beyond YC, so credibility and delivery of the shipments expected in September and October 2026 are the open risks.
notes: Dealroom shows a 125k USD seed with no investor or date and says it was AI generated; kept as unverified, not a round. Outcome search found no shutdown or layoff news. Berkeley SCET names Berkeley as origin while the YC page says San Francisco. A third-party directory claims the Lumoscope specs match IBOOLO dermatoscopes and cites an independent investigation dated 2026-09-12; I could not open that investigation. Founder prior employers come from the YC bio (self-reported).
